title: A Blue Whale's Single Gulp Is 140% of Its Own Body Weight

scenes.text: A blue whale swallows more than its own weight.
It builds up to about four meters a second before it opens up.
Then one gulp takes in water equal to 140 percent of its body mass.
That's roughly the size of a large swimming pool, in seconds.
And some of what it strains out is as small as a paper clip.

description:
A blue whale can swallow a gulp of water equal to about 140 percent of its own body mass.
Stanford researchers say that's roughly the size of a large swimming pool, taken in within seconds.
Could you imagine a mouthful that big?
first_comment: How big is the biggest mouthful you could eat?
